entry_points.text: Create checks capacity and zero prior id, allocates, publishes id, tears down on failure; compat narrowed pointer. Destroy looks up id, teardowns with waiter, blocks until drain else use-after-frees; unknown invalid.
Submit bounds count, ordered until first failure, returns accepted; compat narrow. Cancel matches by address, reports in-flight. Reap min/max plus timeout, extended mask, 32-bit compat.
Compat waits validate narrow/wide timeout/signal then delegate. Installs mask, restores conditionally; empty interrupt restart-no-hand. Bad addresses fault; bad mask aborts.
Early init mounts pseudo fs and allocates shared inode write-protected, assigns ops; either failure halts.

exports.text: Sync whole object or interval with data-only flag; needs file op. Full flushes timestamps then delegates; data-only delegates.
Poll defaults without file op. Translators scale kernel/user words symmetrically, preserve absence, cap 16 bits; cover IN OUT PRI ERR NVAL HUP and RDNORM RDBAND WRNORM WRBAND RDHUP MSG.
Eventfd by descriptor or file with validation and held ref; put frees last. Descriptor lookup returns file or null if invalid/excluded.
Anon files owner ref->source->instantiate; fresh secure or shared; filter access/nonblock, wire mapping; failures release. Descriptors wrap acquisition plus flags to install.

hazards.text: Refill mods head, derives occupancy, caps reclaim; none when empty. User-mutable head must be clamped and limited by occupancy and outstanding; missing bound over-credits visible events.

invariants.text: Lookup index from ring address under hardened RCU, verifies id, refs on match. Acquire allocates, refills if empty, links two refs; failure none. Teardown releases notify/file; put completes once then invalid. Completion unlinks, ends freeze, records status. Submit takes freeze; completion reacquires then ends.
Drain uses sleepable mutex and barrier after tail. Normalizes indices, stops empty, copies chunked by remaining/contiguous/page, fails all on fault, else advances head.
Prep sets position/flags plus async, handles notify/priority, validates flags. Rejects unknown/exclusive, needs support, excludes DAX, merges bits, maps sync, restricts append.
Setup plain single, vectored inline. Dispatch checks prep/mode/iteration, verifies area, calls file; write adds regular freeze; releases vectors. Queued pends; restart interrupt.
Rejects negative count, checks position/wrap except unsigned, then permission/area. Asserts no freeze, skips non-access, HSM pre-content, legacy read-only with access-perm; disabled allows.
Resolution folds range, increments, revalidates, retries, rejects excluded. RCU plus refs stabilize. Recycling risks wrong object; increment-then-revalidate plus dead zone mitigates.

Preparation enforces size/verity, needs auth, strips group; forced skips auth but revokes. Owner self/privileged/unmapped-ns; group current/containing. Suid always, sgid exec/membership; regular unprivileged. Size negative rejected, capped rlimit/signal/max; swap busy; too-large; checks first.
Commit owner/group via mapping, guards mode. Times multigrain or legacy; explicit ctime delegates. Immutable/append denies; immutable touch denied, non-owner needs write.
Helpers for capabilities, ids, groups, compat pointers, atomic version ops support attr, identity, time.

locks.text: Tail/count/occupancy under interrupt-disabled completion lock. Reclaim samples head/tail under same lock, safe stale/fresh with count check.
List removal under context lock. Queue RCU across spinlock if pointer/linked; unlocks spinlock first. Context lock serializes; wakeup trylocks reversing order.

Size/timestamps safe; size sequence/preemption/ordered, timestamps single with masking. Version CAS marker; multigrain marks once. Delegation drops older, clamps future, truncates; races keep fresher.

state_machines.text: Completion publishes wrapping before tail, refreshes views, counts, recycles credits, derives occupancy, signals, wakes. Wait drains first else timers/registers/rechecks/sleeps idle. Dead invalid; empty propagates; mutex can spin.

Poll buffer conditions clear others, 16-bit, ERR/HUP, single, POLLFREE teardown. Flows idle/ready/waiting/scheduled/finished. Context lock with trylock; inline masked no prior; deferred reclaim, forced finish on lock failure, null after detach.

Validates reserved/buffer/len, dispatches pread/pwrite/iov/fsync/poll with resfd; unknown rejected. Flows validate->alloc->bind->dispatch->release; success sync/background, failure restores. Sync no payload, needs support/creds, runs in workqueue under saved creds.

structs.text: Waiter entry plus threshold. Poll table, back pointer, single marker, status for multi-queue/missing.
Query fills attrs then strips type, always succeeds. Update always refuses not-supported.
Identity has fixed name, magic at init, teardown, dynamic dname. Names format prefix plus dentry into buffer tail; overlong fails too-long.
Fill device, inode, mode, links, owners, special device, size, atime, blocksize, blocks. Times multigrain vs stored per mask; cookie needs flag plus version.
